items.title: Southeast Natural Gas Premiums Cool, but West Heats Up
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices strengthened across much of the West and Appalachia Wednesday, while still-elevated Southeast premiums continued to unwind as regional fundamentals pulled the market in opposite directions.

items.title: Natural Gas Bulls Stumble in Latest Charge to Breach $3 Hurdle
items.summary: Natural gas futures deepened their losses Wednesday after the prompt month’s latest charge toward $3.00/MMBtu fell short, with fading shoulder season demand weighing on the front of the curve despite a final burst of late-summer heat.

items.title: Caturus Nearly Doubles Commonwealth LNG Capacity Plans in 5-Train Expansion
items.summary: Houston’s Catarus is expanding its Commonwealth LNG export project in Louisiana, adding five trains and 7.75 Mt/y of capacity as global energy demand surges.

items.title: Western Natural Gas Spot Prices Tread Lightly as Traders Await Storage Shift
items.summary: Traders hit the proverbial pause button on physical natural gas prices ahead of midweek as the market braced for the latest government inventory data and hints of possible increases in western storage after a scorching summer.

items.title: Enbridge Seeks Shippers for 2 Bcf/d Permian Natural Gas Pipeline to El Paso
items.summary: Canadian midstream company Enbridge has launched a non-binding open season for its proposed West Texas Express system.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Push Higher as $3 Stays Out of Reach
items.summary: Natural gas futures moved up early Wednesday as record-challenging heat across the South propped up demand, though softer LNG feedgas and a bearish shift in forecasts beyond the weekend kept the rally in check.
